name: Avatar Studio
intro: Welcome to Avatar Studio in SmartVideo, where you make talking avatar and lip sync videos from a single simple form.

features.model-selector: The model selector at the top shows your current model. Open it to pick another, since different models offer different quality tiers.
features.source-video-image-upload: Next comes the source upload. Add the image or video you want to animate, or browse stock media, because every model needs this starting point.
features.audio-for-lip-sync: Here you upload the voice recording your avatar should speak. The audio drives the mouth movement, so a clean recording gives you better lip matching.
features.prompt-optional: Some models also show an optional prompt box. Use it to describe the animation you want and steer the performance.
features.native-audio-toggle: The Native Audio toggle appears on models that support it. It starts off, and turning it on lets the model generate its own audio.
features.advanced-options: The Advanced panel holds extra options for the model you picked, so you can fine tune the result when the basics are not enough.
features.result-actions: When your video is ready, the result card lets you download it, publish it to social, or add AI captions.

outro: That is Avatar Studio. Pick a model, add your media and voice, and you are ready to bring your first avatar to life.
